'kortare strålningsexponeringstid som' vs '-tiden som': both grammatical.
'den omfattande journal hon' vs 'journalen hon': both grammatical.

'hispaniska' unidiomatic for Hispanic; A 'latinamerikanska' natural; B adds 'kvinnor' not in source.

'den homeostatiska regulator som' vs 'regulatorn som': both grammatical.

'agens' (ett, pl. agensen) is the medical term; A 'agenterna' unidiomatic for infective agents.

B omits medication list (aspirin, clopidogrel etc.), relevant to bleeding workup.

'okben' vs 'zygoma': both acceptable Swedish/Latin anatomical terms.
